name: Flat burger
summary: Flat burger with bun, patty, cheese, lettuce and tomato. Plain and brand-free, for fast food or snack scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the burger rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: cheese
params.note: show the cheese slice with drips

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
